name: Pricing Engagements
description: A warm pricing band: a left intro, a row of three engagement cards with the middle one recommended and highlighted, and a real photo bleeding off the right edge.
interactions: on first view (IntersectionObserver adds .is-inview) the intro and the three cards fade up staggered (wpmn-pe-up 600ms, 80/160ms)
the recommended card carries a warning border, a warning glow, a Recommended badge, a warning icon tile, and a solid warning button; the others use ghost buttons
the right photo bleeds past the section padding with a warm warning-tint overlay
prefers-reduced-motion: content rendered in place, no animation
